subject: Tetrad Y
text: Tetrad Y is used at the end of the game.

evidence.quote: | Name | TETRAD Y...Desc | Used at the end of the game.

subject: Vitamin
text: Vitamin restores all your health.

evidence.quote: | Name | VITAMIN...Desc | Restores all your health.

subject: Main weapons
text: Main weapons are given to you and have unlimited uses.

evidence.quote: Main: These are given to you and have unlimited uses.

subject: Magic weapons
text: Magic weapons kill some baddies that normal weapons cannot and help destroy barriers, but you must have half health to use the most powerful magic weapon you have.

evidence.quote: Magic: These are magic items. They kill some baddies that normal weapons can't, and they help to destroy barriers. To use the most powerful magic weapon you have, you must have half health.

subject: Secondary weapons
text: Secondary weapons are only obtained for a certain amount of time and uses.

evidence.quote: Secondary: You only get them for a certain amount of time and uses.

subject: Bola
text: The Bola has less attack power than the Knife, but has way more range.

evidence.quote: | Name | BOLA...Desc | It has less attack power than the Knife, but has way more range.

subject: Hammer
text: The Hammer will last you the first two dungeons, despite the terrible attack power and limited range.

evidence.quote: | Name | HAMMER...These will last you the first two dungeons, despite the terrible
attack power and limited range.

subject: Katana
text: The Katana has a strong attack power and decent range.

evidence.quote: | Name | KATANA...Desc | It has a strong attack power and decent range.

subject: Knife
text: The Knife is still not a great weapon, but better than the hammer marginally.

evidence.quote: Desc | Still not a great weapon, but better than the hammer marginally.

subject: Psychic Shock Wave
text: The Psychic Shock Wave has short range and decent attack power, and is good on enemies in the pyramid.

evidence.quote: | Name | PSYCHIC SHOCK WAVE...Desc | Short range and decent attack power. Good on enemies in the pyramid.

subject: Rocks
text: Rocks are obtained for a limited time, are short ranged, and have terrible attack power.

evidence.quote: | Name | ROCKS...Desc | You only get these for a limited time...They are short ranged and have terrible...attack power.

subject: Spike Ball
text: The Spike Ball goes in a straight, short line and damages any enemy in its way.

evidence.quote: | Name | SPIKE BALL
Desc | Goes in a straight, short line and damages any enemy in its way.

subject: Super Psychic Shock Wave
text: The Super Psychic Shock Wave has attack power and range that are getting better.

evidence.quote: | Name | SUPER PSYCHIC SHOCK WAVE...Desc | The attack power and range are getting better.

subject: Thrower
text: The Thrower is a much improved version of the rocks.

evidence.quote: | Name | THROWER...Desc | A much improved version of the rocks.

subject: Triple Spike Ball
text: The Triple Spike Ball shoots out three spike balls, meaning more range and different directions of attack, and works great against multiple enemies.

evidence.quote: | Name | TRIPLE SPIKE BALL...Desc | Shoots out three spike balls, meaning more range and different
directions of attack. Works great against multiple enemies!

subject: Ultra Psychic Shock Wave
text: The Ultra Psychic Shock Wave is the strongest of the shock waves.

evidence.quote: | Name | ULTRA PSYCHIC SHOCK WAVE...Desc | As you may have guessed, this is the strongest of the shock waves.

subject: Movement
text: You can move and shoot diagonally, which can make killing enemies a lot easier if you aim right.

evidence.quote: remember you can now move and shoot diagonally, which can make killing enemies a lot easier, if you aim right.

subject: Fireball weapons
text: Along the path towards the cave, you can pick up fireball weapons in action scenes.

evidence.quote: Along the path towards the cave, you may occasionally "fall" into an action scene...pick up the fireball weapons

subject: Axe
text: Once you are in the cave, go to the lower left hand corner and talk to Tink to receive an axe, your first weapon of the game.

evidence.quote: Once you are in the cave, go to the lower left hand corner and talk to Tink. He will hook you up with an axe, your first weapon of the game!

subject: Chief
text: In the cave, the chief is in the northern area and will beg you to defeat Yum Yum when you talk to him.

evidence.quote: Just walk up to him and talk, he's in the northern area. He will beg you to defeat Yum Yum.

subject: Shape drawings
text: The shape drawings on the wall near the guy who says his friend got eaten by Yum Yum hold the clue to beating the dungeon.

evidence.quote: Make sure to write down the shape drawings on the wall near the guy who says his friend got eaten by Yum Yum, as they hold the clue to beating the dungeon.
